g.text: TJ Murphy tag gallery: plan v4 (prototype, issue #251)
Tags are a proposal, not yet approved by TJ.
233 paintings · 12 rooms (sized to their paintings) · central pavilion · 6 walkable courtyards
Cost = sum(sim x hex distance) + walking term: random mean 2865, greedy 1775, annealed 1581 (similarity part
Walk to pavilion (room centre to pavilion centre): mean 24.2 m, max 30.2 m.
Loops: 14 via doors and colonnades, 32 counting courtyard paths (+18). Dead ends: 0. Every room has 3+ doors.
Blank room-wall segments: 0 of 95. Overlaps: 0. All at true size.
Fill = proposed wall colour (light tint of the room palette; swatches = dominant painting colours). Dashed
circle = clear centerpiece zone (ideas are suggestions only).
Light green band = planted terrace between each room and its cell outline. Tan strips with brown dots = open
colonnades (columns on both sides): across each courtyard from a pavilion door, around the pavilion, between
courtyards and along courtyard edges. Blue squares = colonnade views into courtyards.
Courtyards: two fountains each (either side of the crossing colonnade), ring paths, paths out to every
colonnade, planting beds in the corners. Ceilings 6 m in rooms, 4.5 m in colonnades.
Red brackets: tight sets (triptychs in one row in order; Burning Man Temple 2022 four as a 2x2 grid). Wall
markers: coloured bar = painting frame at true width; grey bar = plaque. ~ = estimated size.
